comments.comment: This is because IGNITE-13796 has added this class but did not add its dependencies into pom-standalone file.
Hi ilyak! I've submitted a fix, please have a look.

Create a ticket [1] for auto check standalone projects.

 

[1] https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/IGNITE-14797

Merged into the master.
Thanks for your contribution!
